summary: A docs folder whose index has been changed more than once
description: What file history exists for. `index.md` is written three times; the first commit and one later one touch other files entirely. So the repository has five commits and the index has three — which is the only way to check that the panel is scoped to the open document rather than to the repository. The three versions say which one they are, so a past one can be told apart from the working copy by reading it. The documents are created by the commits rather than sitting in `content/`, because a commit that writes a file already on disk changes nothing and git refuses it.

write.docs/index.md:
# Documentation

The index, as the first commit wrote it.

# Documentation

The index, as the second commit left it.

write.docs/guides/writing.md:
# Writing

A guide, which the index's history must not mention.
